_about: Edward Dennett (1831-1914), Plymouth Brethren writer (not the Africanist R. E. Dennett, whose books share his surname in the catalogue). Added 2026-11-03 by lane A from the Plymouth Brethren line of Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title, edition and date read from each scan's title page or dated preface. No uids minted. All pre-1931, so US public domain.

dennett-heavenly-laws: Heavenly Laws for Earthly Homes: A Manual of the Relative Duties (London: Elliot Stock, 1872)
dennett-fundamental-truths: Fundamental Truths of Salvation: Being Helps for the Anxious and for Young Believers (London: W. H. Broom, 1876)
dennett-typical-teachings-exodus: Typical Teachings of Exodus (London: W. H. Broom, 1882)
